unresolved_critic_weaknesses: The current revision addresses the prior Tuesday compression concern by moving the graded presentation away from the Tuesday sequence of Morning Endurance Session 07:00–09:00, Mandatory anti-doping control 09:05–10:35, immediate Commute to University Campus 10:35–11:05, and presentation at 11:30. The main remaining human-quality and coherence risk is that the Graded Group Presentation is scheduled Thursday 10:00–10:30 while the preserved Strategic Management Seminar runs Thursday 10:00–12:00. This may be acceptable if the presentation is intended to occur within the seminar, but the proposal itself says the Thursday fallback depends on confirmation that it can occur within or replace the seminar.

The central academic event remains conditional on professor and teammate confirmation. The rationale acknowledges this clearly, but the final calendar still presents the Thursday move as selected before that approval is substantiated.

Thursday still has a tight physical-to-academic transition: Morning Gym Conditioning 07:00–09:00, added Commute to University Campus 09:00–09:30, then the graded presentation at 10:00. The 30-minute campus-arrival margin may be sufficient in some contexts, but there is no visible time between training and commute for hygiene, changing, recovery, food, or unexpected training overrun.

The week is already demanding, with protected morning and afternoon training on most visible days. This is mostly pre-existing and not caused by the proposal, but the added anti-doping control and rescheduled graded presentation sit inside a high-load routine where practical margins matter.

The proposal acknowledges that this depends on confirmation that the presentation can occur within or replace the seminar, and also depends on professor and teammate approval. Because the graded presentation is central, high importance, and cannot be skipped, this unresolved condition could significantly affect whether the schedule is realistically workable. There is also a practical readiness concern because Thursday training ends at 09:00, the commute starts immediately at 09:00, and the presentation begins at 10:00, leaving uncertain room for post-training hygiene, changing, recovery, food, setup, or delays.
